description: Use this when a user asks how pump prices have changed over recent days or weeks in a place, or whether fuel is getting cheaper. Returns the daily median and typical range of pump prices in the area, with the change over the period, from our daily snapshots of official data. Do not use for today's cheapest stations. After 10 free calls a day per caller this tool costs USD 0.02 per answered call, paid with x402 (USDC); a 402 reply lists how. Nothing is charged for "not enough records" or errors.

area.description: Wider area when no postcode. AU (Queensland only): 'Brisbane' (postcodes 4000 to 4179) or 'QLD' (the whole state). A suburb name also works. AU (Western Australia only): 'Perth' (the Metro region), 'WA' (the whole state), a FuelWatch region such as 'Peel' or 'South West', or a suburb name. BR: state as a two-letter code or name ('SP', 'Minas Gerais'); leave empty for all Brazil. Ontario: same as town (a market, or Ontario / Southern Ontario / Northern Ontario). Canada: same as town (a city, or 'Canada'). Provinces are not published. CO: department, for example 'Antioquia', 'Cundinamarca', 'Valle del Cauca'. Empty = the whole country. Costa Rica: not used (national price only). ES: province code ('28' = Madrid). EU Weekly Oil Bulletin countries: not used (national average only). FR: department ('69', '2A'). GB: not used (national average only). HK: not used (territory-wide figure only). IT: province ('MI', 'RM'). MX: state name or code ('Ciudad de México', 'CDMX', 'Jalisco', 'NLE'); leave empty for all Mexico. Only states are available. MY: not used (national price only). Netherlands: not used (national average only). Norway: not used (national average only). NZ: not used (national price only). SG: not used (national price only). TH: not used (national price only). TW: not used (island-wide price only). US: a state ('TX', 'California') or PADD region ('Gulf Coast', 'PADD 1B', 'West Coast'); leave empty for the national average. EIA publishes gasoline for CA, CO, FL, MA, MN, NY, OH, TX and WA, diesel only for California plus the nation and PADD regions. Any other place gets the national average, and the answer says so (with its region as context). US heating oil and propane: not used (national average only). Uruguay: not used (national maximum price only).

country.description: AU = Australia, Queensland only (monthly station prices reported to the Queensland Government); AU = Australia, Western Australia only (FuelWatch daily station prices); BR = Brazil (ANP weekly survey: regular petrol and diesel S10); CA = Canada (Ontario markets only here: Ministry of Energy weekly average pump price in CAD per litre; other Canadian places come from Statistics Canada); CA = Canada (Statistics Canada: monthly average retail price by city, official statistic, not a live pump price); CO = Colombia (compressed natural gas only, monthly station prices from SICOM; no gasoline or diesel); CR = Costa Rica (regulator ARESEP: national maximum price, not a station price); ES = Spain; EU Weekly Oil Bulletin, national average pump prices: IE = Ireland, AT = Austria, DE = Germany, NL = the Netherlands, BE = Belgium, PT = Portugal, PL = Poland, DK = Denmark, SE = Sweden, FI = Finland, LU = Luxembourg, GR = Greece, CZ = Czechia, SK = Slovakia, SI = Slovenia, HR = Croatia, HU = Hungary, RO = Romania, BG = Bulgaria, EE = Estonia, LV = Latvia, LT = Lithuania, CY = Cyprus, MT = Malta; FR = France; GB = United Kingdom (DESNZ weekly national average pump prices of unleaded petrol and diesel); HK = Hong Kong (posted pump prices of five oil companies, Consumer Council; posted prices, not station prices); IT = Italy; MX = Mexico (by state); MY = Malaysia (weekly government-set national price; an official published price, not a station price); NL = Netherlands (CBS: daily national average pump price, official statistic, a few days behind); NO = Norway (Statistics Norway: monthly national average pump price, official statistic, not a live pump price); NZ = New Zealand (MBIE weekly national average retail price; an official statistic, not a station price); SG = Singapore (Department of Statistics monthly national average pump price; an official statistic, not a station price); TH = Thailand (EPPO monthly national average retail price; an official statistic, not a station price); TW = Taiwan (posted island-wide list price of CPC Corporation; a posted price, not a station price); US = United States (U.S. Energy Information Administration: weekly average retail gasoline and diesel prices in US$ per gallon for the nation, PADD regions, 9 states and 10 cities); US = United States (EIA: weekly national average residential heating oil and propane prices in US$ per gallon, October to March); UY = Uruguay (ANCAP: monthly maximum pump price set by decree, national, IVA included; not a station price)

days.description: How many recent days to include. Default 30.

fuel.description: petrol95 = unleaded 95; methane = CNG (priced per kg). Queensland: diesel, petrol95 (= standard Unleaded, 91 RON), petrol98, e10, e85 or lpg. Western Australia: diesel, petrol95 (= standard unleaded ULP, 91 RON), petrol98, lpg or e85. Brazil: petrol95 = regular petrol (gasolina comum, not RON 95) or diesel (= diesel S10). Other fuels are not covered. Ontario: petrol95 = regular unleaded, petrol98 = premium unleaded, diesel, propane, methane = compressed natural gas (per litre of gasoline equivalent). E10, E85, LPG and heating oil are not published. Canada: petrol95 = regular unleaded gasoline (87 AKI, about 91 RON), petrol98 = premium unleaded, diesel; self-service stations. E10, E85, LPG and CNG are not published. CO: only methane (vehicular natural gas, GNCV), in COP per cubic metre (not per kg). Gasoline and diesel are not available. Costa Rica: petrol95 (Gasolina RON 95) or diesel (automotive, 50 ppm), the regulated maximum price in colones per litre with IVA. Gasolina RON 91 is given in the answer as extra information. EU Weekly Oil Bulletin countries: petrol95 (Euro-super 95), diesel (automotive gas oil) or lpg, as a national average per litre in euro with all taxes; heating gas oil is in the extra fields. Other fuels are not published. France: petrol95 means SP95 only (about a quarter of French 95-octane stations, and the dearer fuel). Most stations sell E10 instead, which is a separate item and already available: ask for fuel=e10 for the common 95-octane petrol. Also diesel, petrol98 (SP98), e85 and lpg. GB: petrol95 (unleaded petrol, ULSP) or diesel (ULSD) only, as a national average in pounds per litre; other fuels are not published. HK: diesel, petrol95 (the Consumer Council's standard petrol) or petrol98 (premium petrol), in HKD per litre; the answer is the median of five companies' posted prices. Italy: diesel, petrol95, lpg, methane only. Mexico: petrol95 = regular petrol (gasolina regular, Magna), petrol98 = premium petrol, or diesel. Mexican grades are not 95 or 98 RON. MY: diesel, petrol95 (RON95, unsubsidised rate) or petrol98 (answered with RON97). Subsidised BUDI95/SKPS/SKDS prices are in extra.subsidised_myr_per_litre. Netherlands: petrol95 (Euro95), diesel or lpg, as a national daily average per litre in euro with VAT and excise. Premium petrol, E10, E85 and natural gas are not published. Norway: petrol95 (95-octane unleaded) or diesel, as a national monthly average per litre in NOK with taxes. Premium petrol, E10, E85, LPG and CNG are not published. NZ: diesel, or petrol95 (MBIE's Premium Petrol 95R; petrol98 gets the same series). Regular petrol 91 is returned in extra.other_fuels. SG: diesel, petrol95, petrol98 (92-octane petrol is in extra.other_fuels) or lpg (per kg). TH: petrol95 (ULG 95; petrol98 gets the same series), diesel (HSD B7) or lpg (automotive LPG per litre). Gasoline 91 and kerosene are in extra.other_products. TW: diesel (premium diesel), petrol95 (95 unleaded) or petrol98 (98 unleaded), in NT$ per litre with VAT and excise. 92 unleaded and 95E3 gasohol are in the extra fields. US: petrol95 = regular gasoline, petrol98 = premium gasoline, diesel = on-highway diesel (all types). For midgrade gasoline use petrol95 with gasoline_grade=midgrade. Prices are weekly averages in US dollars per gallon, taxes included (US$ per litre is in extra). EIA publishes no E10, E85, LPG or CNG prices. US heating: heating_oil = residential No. 2 heating oil, propane = residential propane, as a national weekly average in US dollars per gallon (per litre in extra). Collected only October to March, so in summer the newest week is from March. For gasoline and diesel use petrol95 or diesel. Uruguay: petrol95 (Super 95) or diesel (gasoil 10-S), as the regulated maximum price per litre in Uruguayan pesos with IVA; premium 97 and gasoil 50-S are in the extra fields. Other fuels are not published.

gasoline_grade.description: US only: the gasoline grade EIA publishes. Overrides the grade implied by fuel (petrol95 = regular, petrol98 = premium); use midgrade here with fuel=petrol95. Not for diesel.

months.description: Instead of days: how many whole months of monthly history to return, where a source has loaded long history.

postcode.description: Postcode of the place. AU (Queensland only): 4-digit postcode starting with 4, e.g. '4122'. Most single postcodes have fewer than 5 stations of one fuel; use area 'Brisbane' or 'QLD' then. AU (Western Australia only): 4-digit postcode starting with 6, e.g. '6000'. BR: not used (the survey is published by state and municipality). Ontario: not used. Canada: not used. CO: not used. Costa Rica: not used; one national price is returned and says so. ES: 5-digit postcode, e.g. '28001'. EU Weekly Oil Bulletin countries: not used; the bulletin publishes one national average per country, so the national figure is returned and says so. FR: 5-digit postcode, e.g. '75015'. GB: not used; DESNZ publishes one UK average, so the national figure is returned and says so. HK: not used (territory-wide figure only). MX: not used. MY: not used (national price only). Netherlands: not used; CBS publishes one national average, so the national figure is returned and says so. Norway: not used; SSB publishes one national average, so the national figure is returned and says so. NZ: not used (national price only). SG: not used (national price only). TH: not used (national price only). TW: not used (island-wide price only). US: not used (EIA publishes no ZIP-code prices). US heating oil and propane: not used (national average only). Uruguay: not used; ANCAP publishes one national price, so the national figure is returned and says so.

service.description: Self-service or attended service, where a country prices them differently. Ontario: not used (the survey does not split self and full service). Canada: self only. Full-service prices stopped in 2013. CO: not used. Costa Rica: not used. EU Weekly Oil Bulletin countries: not used. GB: not used. HK: not used. IT: self-service (default) or attended service, which costs more. MY: not used. Netherlands: not used. Norway: not used. NZ: not used. TH: not used. TW: not used. US: not used. US heating oil and propane: not used. Uruguay: not used.

tax.description: EU Weekly Oil Bulletin countries only: 'with' (default) = the pump price with all duties and taxes; 'without' = the Commission's price net of duties and taxes (VAT and excise removed), the basis many fuel-surcharge indices use. The answer states which. Other countries refuse it with a 400 (they publish pump prices with taxes only).

town.description: Town name. AU (Queensland only): suburb name, e.g. 'Mount Gravatt'. Small suburbs may have fewer than 5 stations. AU (Western Australia only): suburb name, e.g. 'Rockingham'. Small suburbs may have fewer than 5 stations; use a postcode, 'Perth' or 'WA' then. BR: municipality, e.g. 'São Paulo' or 'Curitiba'; add area when the name exists in several states. Ontario: one of Windsor, London, Peterborough, St. Catharines, Sudbury, Sault Ste. Marie, North Bay, Timmins, Kenora, Parry Sound, Toronto East, Toronto West, or Ontario / Southern Ontario / Northern Ontario for the averages. Ottawa, Thunder Bay and Toronto (city) are answered from Statistics Canada. Canada: one of the 18 cities Statistics Canada tracks (St. John's, Charlottetown and Summerside, Halifax, Saint John, Québec, Montréal, Ottawa-Gatineau, Toronto, Thunder Bay, Winnipeg, Regina, Saskatoon, Edmonton, Calgary, Vancouver, Victoria, Whitehorse, Yellowknife), or 'Canada' for the national average (regular unleaded only). Leave town and area out for the national average. CO: municipality, for example 'Medellin' or 'Cali'. Needs at least 5 reporting stations. Costa Rica: not used (national price only). ES: town name, e.g. 'Valencia'. EU Weekly Oil Bulletin countries: not used (national average only). GB: not used (national average only). HK: not used. Prices are for the whole territory; any place is answered with the Hong Kong figure and the answer says so. IT: comune name, e.g. 'Bologna'. MX: not used for cities; a state name given here works like area. MY: not used. One national price per week; any place is answered with the Malaysia price and the answer says so. Netherlands: not used (national average only). Norway: not used (national average only). NZ: not used. MBIE publishes one national price per week; any place is answered with the New Zealand average and the answer says so. SG: not used. One national price per month; any place is answered with the Singapore average and the answer says so. TH: not used. EPPO publishes one national price per month; any place is answered with the Thailand average and the answer says so. TW: not used. CPC posts one island-wide price; any place is answered with the Taiwan price and the answer says so. US: one of the ten cities EIA publishes (Boston, Chicago, Cleveland, Denver, Houston, Los Angeles, Miami, New York City, San Francisco, Seattle), gasoline only; otherwise the national average is returned and the answer says so. US heating oil and propane: not used (national average only). Uruguay: not used (national maximum price only).

name: pricepaid_fuel_price_history

outputSchema.description: A daily series from the ProofPrice price library: date, median, typical range and sample size, with the change over the period.

change.description: Change over the period; null with fewer than two days.

sample_size_note.description: Present when the publisher gives no record count: sample_size in the series is null.

source.description: Where the figure comes from, under which licence, and the attribution line to show.

attribution.description: The attribution line to show with the figure.

url.description: The publisher's page for this data.
